entries.1d8b3ea41b45b96f: The group's business consists of a single segment: the manufacture and sale of food products. Revenue by division for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was centered on the frozen foods division at ¥43,944 million and the perishable daily foods division at ¥10,101 million. Other revenue comprised the canned foods division at ¥1,117 million, the other products division at ¥486 million, and other revenue at ¥1,842 million. Revenue from external customers in Japan exceeds 90%, and the domestic market is the core. The major customer is Mitsubishi Shokuhin Co., Ltd., with revenue of ¥6,699 million and a share of total sales of 11.65%.

entries.3adc85e81e4e60d5: Headquartered in Sagae, Yamagata Prefecture, the company manufactures and sells processed foods (frozen foods, canned foods, retort pouch foods, etc.) and daily-delivery foods (nichihai).
entries.4161275ba7847d4a: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥57,492 million, up 2.9% from ¥55,860 million in the previous consolidated fiscal year. By division, the frozen foods division was ¥43,944 million and the perishable daily foods division was ¥10,101 million.
entries.46abe7f1b15df174: Headquartered in Sagae City, Yamagata Prefecture, the company manufactures and sells processed foods and perishable daily foods. The group consists of 6 consolidated subsidiaries and 1 equity-method affiliate, and consolidated employees for the fiscal year ended March 2026 numbered 1,840.
entries.470489f3a034b975: Its strength lies in its ability to supply a broad range of processed foods, including frozen foods, canned foods, retort pouch foods and perishable daily foods, within one group, through a structure in which the company and the group companies to which production is outsourced manufacture products at plants in various locations. Plants are working to obtain certifications such as ISO9001 and FSSC22000, and are building a system for quality, safety and peace of mind. It also has sales channels other than general retail, such as products for hospitals and nursing care facilities and contract operation of school lunch centers, and growth in the perishable daily foods division and in products for hospitals and nursing care facilities supported revenue growth in the current fiscal year.
entries.4e8fd41423a5b0ab: The company sells to food wholesalers, mass merchants and retail stores, hospitals, nursing care facilities, school lunch facilities and others. Its major customer, which accounts for 11.65% of revenue, is Mitsubishi Shokuhin Co., Ltd.

entries.f1890c852622f58b: This is a business model in which processed foods and perishable daily foods are manufactured at the company's own and group companies' plants, sold to food wholesalers, retailers, hospitals, nursing care facilities and others, and revenue is earned from the sale of products.
entries.f9e4f1a95dcf4314: The company group's basic management policy is to contribute broadly to society in the food industry and work to enhance corporate value, and its mission is to provide food ingredients that enable consumers to enjoy comfortable eating lives. It has formulated the medium-term plan “Reborn & Growing 2028(2024-2028)”, which begins in fiscal 2024, and is working to strengthen sales activities and improve productivity. As the basic strategies of its medium- to long-term management strategy, the company sets out strengthening technological capabilities and achieving high quality that competitors cannot match; restoring the frozen foods division by clarifying priority areas and focus product groups; strengthening organizational capability through a review of organization and operations and a change in mindset; improving human capital through higher employee satisfaction and talent development; and ensuring sustainability through appropriate responses to changes in the business environment.
